args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, which fails tests/test_money.py
(Decimal("2.665") must round to 2.66, not 2.67). Align the code with the
documented FIN-212 requirement and the test expectations.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the documented behavior (and `tests/test_money.py`, per FIN-212) requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `Decimal("2.665")` → `2.66`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed (tests/test_money.py green).

Fixes FIN-212 nightly build failure.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin212
args.title: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (FIN-212)
